item.title: "Antisemitism" is a Western word for a Western crime. The Global South didn't persecute Jewish people. Europe did. But Europe's solution - Israel - was paid for by Palestinian displacement. And when Palestinians object, they're called antisemitic. The West is trying to transfer its guilt onto its other victims. The Global South sees this clearly and feels no guilt hearing that word at all. Never had. In 2026 it doesn't signal hatred. It signals: this is what they need you to stay silent about.
